title: Try props or children before context

slides.say: Context is tempting, so it is easy to overuse. Passing props a few levels deep does not mean you need it.

slides.text: 1. Start with props. A dozen props through a dozen components is OK: the data flow stays clear.
slides.say: First, try plain props. Even a dozen props through a dozen components is fine. It makes it very clear which components use which data.
Second, extract components and pass JSX as children. If Layout only forwards posts, let it take children instead. Fewer layers in between.

slides.text: Good fits: theme, current account, routing, managing state far away.
slides.say: If neither works, use context. Good fits are theming, the current account, routing, and sharing state with distant components.
